summary: Checked the age-line bug fix. Backend: GET /api/events (4 new tests plus the 5 from iteration 1, 9/9 pass). Genres have no age suffix and age_range_en/fr are still filled. Frontend (Playwright, EN and FR): on all 3 event cards the order is name > genre > location > datetime > (recurrence) > distance > age > description > footer. Brumelance genre is 'Immersive adult LARP (Brumelance)' in EN and 'GN immersif adulte (Brumelance)' in FR. The age shows once per card. On the home strip the age line comes after the location/drive-time line on all 3 cards. The Refresh events button was not pressed. Stripe and AI preview were skipped.

issues:
The MapPin icon shrinks to a dot when the location wraps to several lines (Brumelance, Festival des GN). The

uses flex items-center and the icon has no shrink-0. Use items-start plus shrink-0 mt-0.5, as Events.jsx does.

Location text from the data is still in English in FR mode (e.g. 'between Victoriaville and Drummondville', 'near Shawinigan'). Data issue that existed before this fix: there is only one location field.

action_items: Optional: add shrink-0 to the MapPin icon in the Home.jsx event strip
Optional: add location_en/location_fr fields or translate location
critical_code_review_comments: AGE_SUFFIX is applied both when refreshing and when listing. This is fine, but it only removes trailing patterns. A genre like 'Fantasy 12-16' (a non-age number range at the end) would also be removed. That is unlikely and acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported (pytest.ini uses xdist). There are 3 events: Brumelance, Bicolline, Festival des GN. The FR age for Brumelance is '18 ans et plus (...)', not '18+'. Do not press events-ai-refresh-btn.
